q-75520.name: Question 1
q-75520.worked_solution:
We need to calculate the product of $7.3$ with itself:

$$
{7.3}^{2}=(7.3)\cdot (7.3)
$$

First, we ignore the decimal points and multiply as if both numbers were whole numbers:

$$
\begin{aligned} & \begin{aligned} &  &  & \,\,\,\,\begin{aligned}\boxed{2} \\ \boxed{}\end{aligned}\,\,\,\, &  \\  &  &  & \,\,\,\,7\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,3\,\,\,\, \\ \,\,\,\,\times \,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,7\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,3\,\,\,\, \\  &  & \,\,\,\,2\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,1\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,9\,\,\,\, \\ \,\,\,\,+\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,5\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,1\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,1\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,0\,\,\,\, \\  & \,\,\,\,5\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,3\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,2\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,9\,\,\,\,\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $73\times 73=5\,329.$

We now count the total number of decimal places in the two factors.

There is $1$ decimal place in the first factor ($7.3$) and $1$ decimal place in the second factor ($7.3$), so their product will have $1+1=2$ decimal places.

We take our value of $5\,329$ and insert a decimal point to make a number with $2$ decimal places:

$$
53\,\overset{↓}{.}\,\,\,{{29}_{⏟}}_{2\text{ digits}}
$$

Therefore, ${7.3}^{2}=53.29\,.$

q-185181.worked_solution:

$$
\begin{aligned}{(-\frac{8}{5})}^{2} & = \\ (-\frac{8}{5})\cdot (-\frac{8}{5}) & = \\ \frac{8\cdot 8}{5\cdot 5} & = \\ \frac{64}{25} & \end{aligned}
$$

q-185205.name: Question 5
q-185205.problem: Expressed as a decimal in its simplest form, $(-4.5)^{2}=${{field-1}}.
q-185205.worked_solution:
We need to calculate the product of $(-4.5)$ with itself:

$$
(-4.5)^{2}=(-4.5)\cdot (-4.5)=(4.5)\cdot (4.5)
$$

First, we ignore the decimal points and multiply as if both numbers were whole numbers:

$$
\begin{aligned} & \begin{aligned} &  &  & \,\,\,\,\begin{aligned}\boxed{2} \\ \boxed{2}\end{aligned}\,\,\,\, &  \\  &  &  & \,\,\,\,4\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,5\,\,\,\, \\ \,\,\,\,\times \,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,4\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,5\,\,\,\, \\  &  & \,\,\,\,2\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,2\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,5\,\,\,\, \\ \,\,\,\,+\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,1\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,8\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,0\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,0\,\,\,\, \\  & \,\,\,\,2\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,0\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,2\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,5\,\,\,\,\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $45\times 45=2\,025.$

We now count the total number of decimal places in the two factors.

There is $1$ decimal place in the first factor ($4.5$) and $1$ decimal place in the second factor ($4.5$), so their product will have $1+1=2$ decimal places.

We take our value of $2\,025$ and insert a decimal point to make a number with $2$ decimal places:

$$
20\,\overset{↓}{.}\,\,\,{{25}_{⏟}}_{2\text{ digits}}
$$

Therefore, $(-4.5)^{2}=20.25\,.$
